stories.title: Dangerous sneaker waves, 35-foot breakers threaten Oregon Coast for second straight weekend
stories.summary: A week after a child was nearly swept away, dangerous sneaker waves and 35-foot breakers threaten the Oregon Coast once again.

stories.title: No agreement reached between Portland, city workers union; strike, mediation continue
stories.summary: Portland city workers remain on strike after mediation ends without a deal. Negotiations are set to resume Thursday, Nov. 19.

stories.title: A flight delay grounded two Hollywood stars in Eugene. Their reaction went viral.
stories.summary: Stranded in Eugene, Oregon during Friday's FAA ground stop, Daniel Kaluuya and Tyriq Withers made a local TV interview one for the internet.

stories.title: Portland vigil honors lives lost in traffic crashes, calls for safer streets
stories.summary: Advocates and loved ones gathered at Waterfront Park to honor traffic victims and call for safer streets as families push to prevent future deaths.

stories.title: 72 stolen miniature horse figurines recovered after Portland theft of Idaho woman's collection
stories.summary: Portland police recovered 72 stolen miniature horse figurines taken from an Idaho collector's car. About three dozen remain missing.

stories.title: Hundreds rally against Portland Public Schools' plan to close 10 schools
stories.summary: Hundreds of Portland teachers, parents and students marched downtown Saturday to protest a proposal that would close 10 schools in Portland Public Schools.

stories.title: Driver hospitalized after vehicle crashes into Astoria bowling alley
stories.summary: The driver of the vehicle was injured and taken to the hospital. One person was in the building where the crash happened but was not hurt.

stories.title: Driver sentenced to nearly a decade in prison after hitting Portland State University graduate student
stories.summary: Isaac Quinton Ellis hit Mitchell Carlson in 2025, sending him to the hospital. Carlson survived but suffered a traumatic brain injury.

stories.title: Portland Public Schools investigating superintendent's Signal messages ahead of school closure vote
stories.summary: PPS is investigating district leaders' use of an encrypted messaging app, raising concerns among parents as a vote to potentially close 10 schools approaches.

stories.title: Portland Public Schools scales back school closure plan to 10 schools
stories.summary: Sellwood Middle School, James John Elementary, Maplewood Elementary and Stephenson Elementary would remain open under the revised proposal.

stories.title: City says Moda Center deal with Blazers appears unlikely by end of year deadline
stories.summary: The lack of progress on a Moda Center renovation puts $365 million in state funding in jeopardy, prolonging uncertainty over the team's future in Portland.

stories.title: PDX Pop-Up Shops return to downtown Portland with 17 storefronts filled for holiday season
stories.summary: The annual program is in its 17th year, bringing 30 local business owners into previously vacant downtown storefronts through Dec. 24.
